name: Vital Intelligence
summary: In Tirisfal Glades, a new Forsaken carries captured Scarlet Crusade documents from Deathknell to Brill. Executor Zygand awaits the courier there.

sections.title: Leaving Deathknell
sections.body: Executor Arren sends you from Deathknell with captured Scarlet Crusade documents. You have dealt with local threats and intercepted a Scarlet Crusade courier, and are ready for wider service. Leave through Deathknell's sheltered canyon and follow the road east toward Brill, passing Cold Hearth Manor.

sections.title: A Decisive Strike
sections.body: In Brill, Executor Zygand studies the captured correspondence. It names active Scarlet Crusade commanders across Tirisfal Glades and lists their assignments. Zygand plans targeted killings to break the zealots' leadership and morale.

faq.q: What information is inside the Scarlet Crusade Documents?
faq.answer: The captured documents name Scarlet Crusade officers stationed across Tirisfal Glades and list their assignments. Executor Zygand plans swift strikes to eliminate the local leadership and demoralize the Crusade.
Executor Zygand is in Brill, just outside Brill Town Hall beside the town's main square.

faq.q: How do I get to Brill from Deathknell?
faq.answer: Follow the road north out of Deathknell. At the fork into greater Tirisfal Glades, take the eastern path past Cold Hearth Manor, then cross the covered bridge into Brill.

faq.q: Why does this quest signal the end of Deathknell?
aliases: is this the last deathknell quest
faq.answer: Deathknell is the first proving ground for newly awakened Forsaken. After you help secure the hamlet and gather useful intelligence on the Scarlet Crusade, Executor Arren sends you to higher-ranking commanders in Brill.
Executor Arren is the Forsaken officer who oversees operations, security, and the first integration of newly risen undead in Deathknell.

faq.q: What happens after turning in these documents?
faq.answer: Delivering the documents brings you into the wider Forsaken military effort based in Brill. From there, assignments across Tirisfal Glades target local Scarlet Crusade encampments and Scourge remnants.

angles.text: As an Undead, carrying these intercepted plans marks your passage from Deathknell into the wider war for Lordaeron. You have proven yourself after rising from the grave.
As a member of the Horde, you help the Forsaken strengthen their hold on Tirisfal Glades and guard the northern gateway to the Undercity from Scarlet Crusade incursions.
